Yamsuan]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|National Unity Party (Philippines)}}|border=darkgray}} [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|NUP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Parañaque's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the city of [[Parañaque]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 2004.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 9, 2021}} The districts consists of the eastern Parañaque [[barangay]]s of [[BF Homes Parañaque|BF Homes]], [[Don Bosco, Parañaque|Don Bosco]], Marcelo Green, [[Merville, Parañaque|Merville]], [[Moonwalk, Parañaque|Moonwalk]], [[San Antonio, Parañaque|San Antonio]], [[San Martin de Porres, Parañaque|San Martin de Porres]] and [[Sun Valley, Parañaque|Sun Valley]].{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=9229|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2003/ra_9229_2003.html |title=An Act Amending Sections 8(a) of Republic Act No. 8507 Entitled, "An Act Converting the Municipality of Parañaque Into a Highly Urbanized City to Be Known as the City of Parañaque" |publisher=The Lawphil Project - Arellano Law Foundation, Inc.|date= December 17, 2003 |accessdate=February 9, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Brian Yamsuan]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 13, 2023}} The Parañaque City Hall is located in this district. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
